description: Elections Commission - Notify the name of Ilayawan Mayilvakanam as a member of the Valikamam-East Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Valikamam East Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for selecting a new member, including the role of a political party secretary and the declaration by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and related administrative matters, making it an Elections Gazette.
